items.name: Techfest Cube Mania 2013
items.information: On day registration is compulsory between 8:00 hrs to 10:00 hrs on Day 1 of the competition i.e. 3rd January 2013. If the participant fails to register within the given time slot, Competitor will not be allowed to participate in competition. No exceptions would be entertained.                                                                                       Note: Pre-Registration is not considered as Registration. Only People registered on-day would be eligible to participate in the Event

items.name: Moscow North-West Open Winter 2013
items.information: Registration will be closed on December, 29 or when we reach 60 competitors. Please, note that all registrations must be confirmed by e-mail.
